flows.note: Ending WETH equals mints plus buy inflows plus direct inflows, minus burns, sells, and direct outflows, within 2 wei. The 0.30% fee stays inside amount-in, so it is not a separate term. ERC-20 balance and the last Sync agree.

failed.title: WETH reserves were depleted
failed.effect: Ending reserves retained about 0.0% of the peak observed WETH reserve. Displayed price can collapse when the quote side is emptied.
failed.summary: The pool ended at 0.000000000002 WETH after starting at 0.8 WETH.
failed.unknown: Off-chain reasons participants chose to sell are not visible in the logs.
failed.mechanism: Reserves fell through swaps. Burned or locked LP tokens do not stop a trader from selling the base token into the pool.
failed.whatHappened: Buyers sent 16.705006 WETH into the pair and sellers withdrew 17.505006 WETH.
failed.whatWouldHelp: The indexed Swap and Sync events already measure the reserve path.

failed.title: One swap repriced the pool immediately
failed.effect: This sale explains its own price change. It is not, by itself, an explanation of every later print.
failed.summary: Inside 0x2d1ee2d1fd80d2ff15a6289e6b04a4e4660f49f0c754c16534173789f0695325, 1.003e-12 of the pre-swap spot price remained. The quote reserve after this swap was not zero.
failed.unknown: How much of the later path was follow-on selling versus an empty book.
failed.mechanism: Constant-product reserves move to a new price as soon as the swap is mined. Later candles have their own swaps.
failed.whatHappened: Immediate impact compares the reserve price before the swap with the reserve price after that same swap. This is the largest immediate move in the indexed sells, which may differ from the wallet with the largest total proceeds.
failed.whatWouldHelp: The reserve series after this transaction.

failed.title: Token source is not verified
failed.effect: Buyers could not read the permission model from a published source match at analysis time.
failed.summary: Sourcify has no source match. Etherscan was not queried because no API key is configured.
failed.unknown: The actual permission model. A safety rating is not assessed.
failed.mechanism: Unverified bytecode can contain trading limits, taxes, or mint functions that a selector scan only hints at.
failed.whatHappened: The analyzer checked Sourcify and, when a key was configured, Etherscan. Bytecode was still readable.
failed.whatWouldHelp: A verified source match on Sourcify or Etherscan, plus the deployment transaction.

failed.title: Independent participation was not identifiable
failed.effect: Strengths that depend on organic demand stay limited. Address counts remain available.
failed.summary: No known-external wallets were supplied, and unclassified addresses were not treated as organic buyers.
failed.unknown: Which unclassified addresses, if any, were independent participants.
failed.mechanism: The analyzer only promotes a wallet to known-external when the user lists it. Shared timing or trade size is not used as ownership evidence.
failed.whatHappened: 194 buying addresses remain a mix of possible team wallets, independent wallets, and contracts.
failed.whatWouldHelp: The external addresses the operator already knows were outside the team.

launch.firstBuyerNote: 0x1d7584c3a7d80599fa4d64579afb94b5c61f3fcc is the first buy sender other than the liquidity sender. That does not establish an independent person.

scores.label: Market participation
scores.formula: min(40, unique buy addresses × 2) + round((1 − largest buyer share) × 40) + min(20, addresses with more than one buy). Address counts are not people. Known-external participation is reported separately and is Not Assessed when no list is supplied.
scores.explanation: This score measures how widely observed buy flow was spread across sending addresses.

scores.label: Liquidity resilience
scores.formula: round(100 × ending quote reserve ÷ peak quote reserve). LP burns do not increase this score. A burned LP can still sit beside an empty quote reserve.
scores.explanation: The score is the share of the peak quote reserve still in the pool at the last indexed Sync.

scores.label: Wallet distribution
scores.formula: 100 × (1 − Σ share²) using each address's buy quote. 100 would be an even split across a very large set. The score does not prove distinct humans.
scores.explanation: Higher means buy quote was less concentrated in a few sending addresses.

scores.label: Contract transparency
scores.formula: 25 when bytecode is available and no source match was found. Safety is Not Assessed. The score records disclosure, not exploit risk.
scores.explanation: Safety is Not Assessed because the source is not verified. Selector hits in bytecode are hints and can be false matches.

scores.label: Launch operations
scores.explanation: No operational context was entered, so this category was left unscored.

worked.title: LP tokens were sent to a burn address
worked.effect: The launch operator could not pull the initial deposit back out as an LP withdrawal. Quote tokens could still leave through swaps.
worked.summary: 0.8944 LP tokens are held by the burn address.
worked.unknown: A later mint of new LP tokens would be a separate event. None is implied by the burn transfer alone.
worked.mechanism: Sending LP tokens to a burn address prevents the holder of those LP tokens from calling removeLiquidity. It does not freeze the quote reserves.
worked.whatHappened: LP tokens moved to the burn address. The Uniswap V2 minimum liquidity of 1000 wei sits at the zero address when that transfer is present.
worked.whatWouldHelp: The LP Transfer to the burn address and a zero Burn-event count already settle this question for the indexed range.

worked.title: WETH reserve reconciliation closed
worked.effect: Pool accounting for the indexed range does not depend on a chart screenshot.
worked.summary: Ending WETH matches initial deposits plus swap inflows minus swap outflows.
worked.unknown: Events outside the indexed block range are not in this sum.
worked.mechanism: Each Swap and Mint event records the quote amount that entered or left the pair. The sum is compared with the final Sync reserve and the token balance.
worked.whatHappened: Ending WETH equals mints plus buy inflows plus direct inflows, minus burns, sells, and direct outflows, within 2 wei. The 0.30% fee stays inside amount-in, so it is not a separate term. ERC-20 balance and the last Sync agree.
worked.whatWouldHelp: An archive provider covering any earlier gap, if the log scan was truncated.

worked.title: Swap outputs match the Uniswap V2 formula
worked.effect: The indexed swaps behave like a standard 0.30% pool. This does not rule out a tax taken before tokens reach the pair.
worked.summary: Median actual output ÷ constant-product quote is 1.0000.
worked.unknown: A fee charged on the wallet before the pair's balance update would not appear in this ratio.
worked.mechanism: Expected output uses amountOut = amountIn × 997 × reserveOut ÷ (reserveIn × 1000 + amountIn × 997), measured from the prior reserve.
worked.whatHappened: Median actual output divided by the Uniswap V2 0.30% quote is 1.0000 across 377 swaps. Values near 1 match the pair formula.
worked.whatWouldHelp: Compare the wallet's token transfer amount with the pair's amountIn on the same transaction.

worked.title: Many distinct addresses submitted buys
worked.effect: The launch produced broad address-level activity. Independence of those addresses is a separate question.
worked.unknown: How many of those addresses were controlled by the operator or by independent participants.
worked.mechanism: One person can submit transactions from many addresses. The count is not a count of people.
worked.whatHappened: Buy swaps were grouped by the transaction sender. That count is an address count.
worked.whatWouldHelp: A user-supplied known-external list, plus funding and direct-transfer evidence.

worked.title: User-reported initial liquidity matches the mint
worked.effect: The operator's recollection of the seed deposit agrees with the pair event.
worked.summary: The note cited about 0.8 WETH. The first Mint deposited 0.8 WETH.
worked.mechanism: String match within 2% of the parsed number.
worked.whatHappened: The user-supplied note was compared with the first Mint event. The chain figure is the one used in accounting.
worked.whatWouldHelp: No further evidence is required for the seed amount.

holders.detail: Holders are addresses with a positive replayed balance, excluding the pair, the zero address, and the burn address. Addresses are not people.

overall.disclaimer: The average covers only categories with enough evidence. It is a diagnostic scorecard, not a safety rating, a profit forecast, or a prediction of the next launch.

summary.tokenTaxNote: Median actual output divided by the Uniswap V2 0.30% quote is 1.0000 across 377 swaps. Values near 1 match the pair formula.

narrative.executive: BARSTRO traded against WETH in pair 0x0D108526a484Eb7927e593fd41D8a8823fc35650 on chain 1. The indexed window is blocks 26157104 to 26157533. The first Mint, in 0xdeb613e3da3a73587b8d1341f9216e512cb7111dcb5cc58bd145e79ef9f6c638 at 2026-10-09T20:00:11 UTC, deposited 1000000000 BARSTRO and 0.8 WETH. Spot price and FDV in this report use that reserve pair and the token total supply. USD figures multiply WETH by an ETH/USD reference (DefiLlama historical ETH/USD) and are estimates. The highest reserve price in the indexed swaps printed at 2026-10-09T20:55:59 UTC in 0x00dee4b8bff1bb3def4dc54ec64e3e9bb45faa13bbf400e50349eeb5eeb8919a. Fully diluted value at that print was about 54.5871 WETH ($135,417 at the ETH reference). From the running peak to the trough, 1.218e-13 of the reference price remained, between 2026-10-09T20:55:59 UTC and 2026-10-09T21:26:11 UTC. The pool recorded 253 buys and 124 sells from 195 sending addresses. Buy WETH was 16.705006 and sell WETH was 17.505006. The address that submitted the initial liquidity transaction was 0x45b5f80d0160a977c2a5d2b9060997d5cfe0ca65. This address is the transaction sender on the first Mint (0xdeb613e3da3a73587b8d1341f9216e512cb7111dcb5cc58bd145e79ef9f6c638). External wallet ownership has not been established. Organic participation estimates are limited. Ending WETH reserve was 0.000000000002 and ending BARSTRO reserve was 352161590.038. LP tokens at the burn address cannot call removeLiquidity. The quote reserve can still fall when traders swap the base token in and take quote tokens out. That path is a sell, not an LP removal.
narrative.strengths: 0.8944 LP tokens are held by the burn address. Ending WETH matches initial deposits plus swap inflows minus swap outflows. Median actual output ÷ constant-product quote is 1.0000. 194 buying addresses were observed. The note cited about 0.8 WETH. The first Mint deposited 0.8 WETH.

Inside 0x2d1ee2d1fd80d2ff15a6289e6b04a4e4660f49f0c754c16534173789f0695325, 1.003e-12 of the pre-swap spot price remained. The quote reserve after this swap was not zero. Sourcify has no source match. Etherscan was not queried because no API key is configured. No known-external wallets were supplied, and unclassified addresses were not treated as organic buyers.

limitations: The token creation transaction was not recovered from the scanned blocks. The launch operator is the sender of the first liquidity transaction, which is not automatic proof of contract creation.
Token source is unverified, so privileged functions cannot be confirmed from a source match. Safety is not assessed.
Sending addresses are not people. One operator can control many wallets.
Realized PnL uses average cost on pool trades only. Gas is reported separately and is not subtracted from that figure.
Pool outflows are quote tokens leaving the pair. They are profit only after a wallet's own cost basis is reconstructed.
